_doc: BD40 (backdrop lane, 2026-10-11): the cinematic preset with the distance haze matched to the page's: the exponential height fog's density x 0.25 (ue_light.py FOG day 0.006 -> 0.0015): along the probes' lines of sight UE's day fog (density / 1000 per cm, base 2, falloff 0.12) holds 4.3 times the page's optical depth from 250-300 m up and 3.5 times from the street (the page: 0.00016 per metre at its -25 m fog base, falloff 0.011, client/public/settings/graphics.json and weather.js), so x 0.25 brings both within about 10 % of the page's (UELOOK10 had measured about 4.5 times); everything else as render_take_cine.json. R1C (lane C, 2026-10-11): the trailer's cinematic preset of tools/ue/render_take.sh (--preset cine): the one-sample settings with 8 temporal samples a frame (the shutter's motion blur from the samples, the post-process blur off), Lumen with hardware ray tracing at cinematic quality (final gather 4, reflections, scene detail and lighting 4, screen probes at half the downsample, traced reflections to roughness 0.6, translucency's front layer), virtual shadow maps a level and a half sharper with 16 rays of 8 samples, a physical sky (sky atmosphere, volumetric clouds, a sky light that captures them), the exposure per shot (ev_shot, EV over the page's), 64 warm-up frames
